name: duel-arena-app
description: DUEL ARENA smartphone landscape app; upstream game is preserved byte-for-byte.

scripts.native:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync && node scripts/configure-native.mjs
scripts.test: node --test tests/app.test.mjs && node tests/rules-regression.cjs && node tests/audio-startup.cjs
scripts.android: npm run native:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run native:sync && npx cap open ios
